source.body:
### Bug Description

The close button of the nodes panel has its screen reader label written in English straight into the code: "Close Node Creator". Screen reader users with another UI language still hear it in English.

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/66ef8460d2fb460cc1a0303bf93b0e9d7409cf8e/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/shared/nodeCreator/components/NodeCreator.vue#L214

### To Reproduce

1. Set the UI to a language other than English.
2. Open a workflow and press **N** to open the nodes panel.
3. Inspect the X button next to the panel. Its `aria-label` is still "Close Node Creator".

### Expected behavior

The `aria-label` is in the selected language, like the rest of the nodes panel.

### Debug Info

I found this while reading the code on `master` (2.49.0). The text is written into the code, so it happens on every setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.49.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a
